response.original_title: «Я РАЗОБЬЮ ТЕБЕ ЛИЦО!» / Пропитый треш-салон и угрозы моей жизни
response.overview: In 2024, a social media scandal erupted between Elena Bogacheva and me over a subscriber of mine who lost part of her hair after receiving a service at Elena's beauty salon! Two years later, I returned to conduct my own investigation and show what was behind the pretty picture on social media. What I documented was beyond all bounds!  In addition to the complete unsanitary conditions in the salon itself, I discovered what people have been saying for a long time: wild animals are living in the salon. Eyewitnesses are sounding the alarm and claiming the animals need to be rescued. What's really going on there? Find out right now 🔥🚨 Don't try to repost this video on other social media, you'll get a strike!
